method.return: Adj Close(end)/Adj Close(start)-1; split/dividend-adjusted tax-before return proxy; no personal commissions or taxes
method.window: End is latest actual valid daily close on/before requested asof; start is last session on/before one calendar year earlier; young funds use first available inception close
method.volatility: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of simple daily return proxy * sqrt(252), expressed in percent
method.max_drawdown: minimum of 100*(return_proxy/running_max(return_proxy)-1) within same return window; closing observations only, no lookahead
method.moving_averages: 50/200 latest available split-adjusted provider Close observations; missing if insufficient; not dividend-adjusted
method.drawdown_52w: latest Close vs max intraday High in trailing 364 calendar days; missing without full window; separate from maximum drawdown
